description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Covers for the Recline Mechanisms.
Includes Both Sides
COLOR: Gray
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Seat Recline Mechanism COVER – LH Side (Drivers Side)
Qty 1 – Seat Recline Mechanism COVER – RH Side (Passengers Side)
Qty 2 – Installation Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
